metaTitle: Pail: desktop app and CLI for Amazon S3 and S3-compatible storage
metaDescription: Pail is a free, open-source desktop app and command line for Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, MinIO and other S3-compatible storage, on Windows, macOS and Linux.
heroTitle: Your S3 buckets, on the desktop.
heroLede: A desktop app and command line for Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, MinIO, VersityGW and any other service with the S3 API. For Windows, macOS and Linux. Free and open source.
windowLead: One window for the whole account.
windowRest: Buckets, objects, the selected item and transfers, side by side.
shotAlt: The Pail main window: bucket list, object table and inspector
transfersBody: Every upload and download is a task you can pause, resume, cancel or retry, and an unfinished one is still in the queue after you quit. Large files travel in parts of 5 MiB to 5 GiB, each with its own checksum. A download is written to a temporary file and takes its real name only once it checks out.
versionsBody: On a bucket with versioning, Pail lists every version and delete marker of a key. Download or restore an older version, undo a delete, or remove for good only the versions you pick.
linksTitle: Share a file, not the bucket.
linksBody: Presigned GET and PUT links for one object, one version or a whole selection, valid for as long as you choose. When the account has a CDN domain, you can copy the CDN address of an upload instead.
syncBody: A sync job uploads, downloads or mirrors a folder. It compares by size and time, by size alone or by checksum, skips the patterns you exclude, and lists every upload and delete before a single file moves.
moreLead: And the rest of the console.
moreRest: Bucket settings, object properties and the less frequent jobs are in the same app.
more: rules~Upload rules~Match a bucket and key pattern to set headers, storage class and encryption, or to compress with GZIP, ZIP or AES-256 ZIP.|buckets~Bucket settings~Versioning, encryption, public access, lifecycle, CORS, replication and eight more, as a form or as JSON.|props~Object properties~Headers, metadata, tags, ACL, storage class and server-side encryption, for one object or a selection.|archive~Archive restore~Bring objects back from S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval or Deep Archive for the number of days you set.|accounts~Accounts~Access keys, AWS profiles, the default credential chain, AssumeRole or anonymous access, with any endpoint and region.|cdn~CloudFront~Create invalidations and turn distributions on or off for AWS accounts.|proxy~Proxy and limits~HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5, for every account or one. Separate upload and download speed limits.|palette~Command palette~Ctrl K, or ⌘K on macOS, finds commands, tools and buckets by name.|lang~English and Chinese~The whole app in English and Simplified Chinese, in light and dark.
cliLead: The command line is in the same archive.
cliRest: pail reads the accounts, sync jobs and settings of the desktop app, prints JSON on request and exits with documented codes.
cliNote: The terminal shows output recorded from pail. Keys and signatures are shortened.
privLead: No telemetry. Update checks only when you ask.
privRest: Pail connects to the endpoints of the accounts you add, and to GitHub or pail.download only to check for updates.
priv: Secrets~Secret keys, session tokens and proxy passwords go to the system keychain, or to an encrypted vault on systems without one.|Logs~Off until you turn them on. Query strings, Authorization headers, signatures and known secrets are removed before a line is written.|Confirmation~Deletes, moves and syncs that delete show what they will touch first. To delete a bucket, you type its name.
dlBody: Each archive holds the desktop app and pail. There is no installer: unpack it and start the app.
dlNote_windows: Not code-signed. If SmartScreen stops the app, choose More info, then Run anyway.
dlNote_macos: macOS 11 or later. Not notarized: clear the quarantine flag once before the first launch.
dlNote_linux: Includes a .desktop entry and an icon.

objectsTitle: A bucket opens like a folder.
objectsBody: Double-click a folder, or select it and press Enter, to open it. The filter keeps the names that contain what you type, Flat lists every object below the folder, and the inspector shows the selection in six tabs.
